title: Chapter 281 Undead Confrontation List
content:
Chapter 281 Undead Confrontation List

Finally, Hazamu rushed out of the swamp.

As long as he showed his head, it would be easy!

Wang Shuo used the round-robin strategy again, ordering all the three-headed dogs of hell to attack him in turn, while he did his best to entangle him and prevent him from escaping.

Hazamu was also anxious and kept trying to break through.

After an incense stick, Hazamu finally fell.

[You killed Hazamu, the young commander of the Burning Legion in Black Dragon City, ID...]

[You won the defense of Wana Town, reputation +200, command +2]

[Your level has been raised to level 37. ]

Wang Shuo waited for a while and found that there was no system announcement.

It seems that he is not the first lord to win.

In the distance, there is an altar with a dead air, and Wang Shuo destroyed it without hesitation.

Finally, the system prompt sounded.

[You have entered the "Undead Confrontation" ranking. ]

Wang Shuo opened this ranking.

It was found that the ranking was based on the number of altars destroyed.

No wonder.

At this time, the number of people on the list was 1.

But Wang Shuo ranked 11th.

This surprised Wang Shuo. Among the ten forces in front, 4 were villages and 6 were towns.

No matter which one it was, it must have been wiped out with a crushing force.

If Wana Town did not divide its troops, with the strength of the Red Flame Army, plus Gong Zheng, Goode, and Ayub, it should not be a big problem to deal with a golden boss.

But Wang Shuo had nothing to regret.

After collecting the spoils, Wang Shuo immediately returned to the town.

After making a simple arrangement for the affairs of the territory, he took his personal guards and teleported to Nanshanji.

The city wall of Nanshanji had long been renovated by Wang Shuo. Fortunately, the former mayor Lin Guanru laid a solid foundation. Otherwise, Wang Shuo would not have been able to repair the city wall in such a short time.

The main generals of Wana Town have all gathered here.

"Abu, tell me about the situation!"

"The leader on the opposite side is a SS named Takur. We haven't fought him yet, but we have repelled three waves of their attacks."

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

Without the output of heavy long-range firepower such as catapults and crossbows, it is still very difficult to repel the army of undead.

"It's time for us to take the initiative to attack."

For this battle, Wang Shuo did not intend to stick to it.

Obviously, if you want to strive for a higher ranking, you must take the initiative to attack and destroy more altars.

Ayub's golden fire cavalry has expanded to 2,000 people, and 200 of them have replaced their mounts with flame horses. Each warhorse is equipped with a flame saddle and covered with heavy horse armor. It can be called the ace among heavy cavalry.

Good's archer cavalry has also developed to 1,000 people, each with a hundred-step piercing bow, and each person is also equipped with a bronze long sword, which has both medium-range attack capabilities and close combat capabilities.

Wang Shuo officially named the Hellhounds as the Knights of Hell, and he was appointed as the leader.

The three fast-moving troops gave Wang Shuo confidence in the upcoming war.

"Let this Takur sacrifice the flag for us to fight against the army of the undead!"

The three troops, each with several people, held up the military flag of Wana Town, fluttering in the wind under the Nanshanji City.

On the gate tower, the drums of war thundered and the horns of attack sounded.

"Fight!"

"Fight!"

"Fight!"

...

The Red Flame Army shouted loudly, and the sound shook the four fields!

Wang Shuo looked at the Burning Legion on the opposite side, who was ready for battle, and his fighting spirit was aroused and his blood boiled.

Zou Yuanjie released the "high morale", and Ayub started the "Iron Cavalry Charge".

Good's archers were arranged in front of the Hell Knights and the Golden Fire Cavalry in a crane wing formation, and took the lead in launching an attack.

Wang Shuo and Ayub also led their respective troops and began to accumulate strength, preparing to launch a fatal charge.

...
